text: In September 2025, investment funds affiliated with Rhône, a global private equity firm established in 1996, acquired Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers from Thompson Street Capital Partners.
short: Freddy's is owned by investment funds affiliated with the private equity firm Rhône.

source.name: Greenberg Traurig: Greenberg Traurig Represents Rhône in Acquisition of Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers
source.quote: represented investment funds affiliated with Rhône, a global private equity firm, in connection with its acquisition of Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers from Thompson Street Capital Partners
